services.name: Chicago Boat Rentals
services.desc: From bachelorette parties to corporate events, our tiki boats fit groups of 12 to 20. Bring your crew, bring your cooler, we’ll bring the boat and the skyline. Getting out on the water is easier than you think. Three simple steps and your crew is cruising Lake Michigan or the Chicago River with everything you need for an amazing time aboard. Compare the fleet, pick the boat that fits your crew, and we'll handle Lake Michigan. Our flagship boat, built for 12 of your closest crew. Waterslide, gas grill, lily pad, floaties, and a cooler with 20lbs of ice come standard. Made for bachelorette parties, birthday celebrations, and summer days on Lake Michigan or the Chicago

blurb: Guests book private charters aboard tiki-themed boats with USCG licensed captains. Cruises operate on Lake Michigan and the Chicago River from Monroe Harbor. The experience includes a private boat rental with BYOB freedom and a waterslide.
extraNote: 50% deposit required at booking to lock reservation · Remaining balance due 30 days before rental date; full payment required if booking within 30 days · Cancellation refunds vary by notice period: 100% refund if more than 30 days, 75% if 15-21 days, 50% if 8-14 days, 25% if 2-7 days, no refund if less than 48 hours · Company may cancel or reschedule due to weather, mechanical issues, safety, or restrictions; full refund or reschedule offered · Late arrivals forfeit booking after 30 minutes with no refund · 400 E Monroe St, Monroe Harbor, Chicago, IL · Summer season
